name: Dena A. Reecer
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Denton, Texas
education: Texas Tech University School of Law
about: The owner of The Reecer Law Firm, P.L.L.C., in Denton, Texas, Dena A. Reecer is an estate planning and probate attorney, assisting clients with legal matters, such as estate administration, wills and trusts, and probate litigations. She represents clients in and around Denton and Dallas.

Rooted in Texas, Ms. Reecer has a bachelor’s degree in government from The University of Texas at Austin. She was first admitted to practice in Texas in 1988, after graduating with a law degree from the Texas Tech University School of Law. Her other bar admissions include the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Texas (1990) and the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas (1991).

Ms. Reecer is a specialist in estate planning and probate law, board-certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. She helps clients with a wide range of issues related to estate planning and estate administration – taxable and nontaxable estates, asset protection, family wealth preservation, and contested estate and trust matters.

A former assistant district attorney, Ms. Reecer is well respected by her clients and peers for her professionalism, diligence and attention to detail. She has been peer-review rated as BV Distinguished* through Martindale-Hubbell, and Avvo has rated her 10 out of 10. In addition, the Texas Monthly magazine has listed her among the Top 10 Women Attorneys in 2021.

Practicing law for more than three decades, Ms. Reecer stays active in the legal community by being a part of several professional associations. She is a fellow of the Texas Bar Foundation and a member of the Denton County Bar Association, the State Bar of Texas’ Real Estate, Probate and Trust Law sections, and the College of the State Bar of Texas.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
